description: The line plot illustrates the Mean Reciprocal Rank at position 10 (MRR@10) as a function of the number of queries used during inference (S), with values ranging from 1 to 10 on the x-axis. The y-axis represents MRR@10, scaled from 33.0 to 36.0. Three distinct methods are compared: "DPR w/o query" (black solid line), "DPR w/ corpus expansion" (red solid line with circular markers), and "DPR w/ document expansion" (green solid line with triangular markers). The black line remains relatively flat, hovering around 34.1 across all query counts. The red line starts at approximately 34.9 and shows a steady increase, reaching about 35.8 by S = 10. The green line begins at roughly 34.7, fluctuates slightly, and ends at approximately 34.7. The red line consistently achieves the highest MRR@10 values, followed by the green line, while the black line remains the lowest.
